# Dropdown Menu

A contextual menu that opens on trigger. Built on Radix DropdownMenu for keyboard navigation, focus management, and a11y; animated with interruptible enter/exit transitions.

```tsx
<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline">My account</Button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent className="w-56">
    <DropdownMenuLabel className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
      <span>Alex Johnson</span>
      <span className="font-normal text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        alex@example.com
      </span>
    </DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuGroup>
      <DropdownMenuItem>
        <UserCircle /> Profile
        <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘P</DropdownMenuShortcut>
      </DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuItem>
        <BellSimple /> Notifications
      </DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuItem>
        <CreditCard /> Billing
        <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘B</DropdownMenuShortcut>
      </DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuItem>
        <Gear /> Settings
        <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘,</DropdownMenuShortcut>
      </DropdownMenuItem>
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuGroup>
      <DropdownMenuItem>
        <Users /> Team
      </DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuSub>
        <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
          <Plus /> Invite members
        </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
        <DropdownMenuSubContent className="w-48">
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <Envelope /> Email
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <Link /> Copy invite link
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuItem>
            <ChatCircle /> Send message
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuSubContent>
      </DropdownMenuSub>
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive">
      <SignOut /> Log out
      <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘Q</DropdownMenuShortcut>
    </DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add dropdown-menu
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/dropdown-menu/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import {
  DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuShortcut,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Gear, SignOut, UserCircle } from "@phosphor-icons/react"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline">My account</Button>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent className="w-48">
        <DropdownMenuLabel>My account</DropdownMenuLabel>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <UserCircle /> Profile
          <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘P</DropdownMenuShortcut>
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <Gear /> Settings
          <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘,</DropdownMenuShortcut>
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive">
          <SignOut /> Log out
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  )
}
```

## Avatar trigger

Any element can be the trigger via `asChild`. A common pattern is a header avatar that opens an account menu, with the signed-in identity repeated as a non-interactive label at the top.

```tsx
<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <button
      aria-label="Open user menu"
      className="cursor-pointer rounded-full outline-none ring-brand ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background transition-transform duration-fast ease-out focus-visible:ring-2 active:scale-[0.96]"
    >
      <Avatar size="md">
        <AvatarImage src="/avatar.jpg" alt="Jordi Espinosa" />
        <AvatarFallback>JE</AvatarFallback>
        <AvatarStatus variant="online" />
      </Avatar>
    </button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-60">
    <DropdownMenuLabel className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2 font-normal">
      <Avatar size="sm">
        <AvatarImage src="/avatar.jpg" alt="Jordi Espinosa" />
        <AvatarFallback>JE</AvatarFallback>
      </Avatar>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium leading-none text-foreground">
          Jordi Espinosa
        </p>
        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">jordi@koala.ui</p>
      </div>
    </DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuGroup>
      <DropdownMenuItem>
        <UserCircle /> Profile
      </DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuItem>
        <CreditCard /> Billing
      </DropdownMenuItem>
      <DropdownMenuItem>
        <Gear /> Settings
      </DropdownMenuItem>
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive">
      <SignOut /> Log out
    </DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

## Icon button trigger

A ghost `iconOnly` button makes a compact “more actions” menu for table rows and card headers. Align the content to the trigger edge with `align="end"`.

```tsx
<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="ghost" iconOnly aria-label="More actions">
      <DotsThree />
    </Button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-44">
    <DropdownMenuItem>
      <PencilSimple /> Edit
    </DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem>
      <Copy /> Duplicate
    </DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem>
      <ShareNetwork /> Share
    </DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive">
      <Trash /> Delete
    </DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

## Keyboard shortcuts

`DropdownMenuShortcut` renders the small gray `Kbd` chip at the row's end. It is purely decorative: wire up the actual key binding in your app with a global listener.

```tsx
<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline">Edit</Button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent className="w-52">
    <DropdownMenuLabel>Edit</DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem>
      <FilePlus /> New file
      <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘N</DropdownMenuShortcut>
    </DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem>
      <PencilSimple /> Rename
      <DropdownMenuShortcut>F2</DropdownMenuShortcut>
    </DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuSub>
      <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
        <ShareNetwork /> Share
      </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuSubContent className="w-44">
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <Envelope /> Email link
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <Link /> Copy link
          <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘L</DropdownMenuShortcut>
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <ChatCircle /> Messages
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuSubContent>
    </DropdownMenuSub>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive">
      <Trash /> Delete
      <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌫</DropdownMenuShortcut>
    </DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

## Switch items

For a setting that applies the moment it flips, pass `variant="switch"` to a checkbox item. The row draws a switch on the same line as the shortcut and the check, and the menu stays open when it is toggled (`closeOnSelect` is off for switches), so several can be set in one visit. The row is still a menu checkbox with its checked state announced; the switch is its drawing, not a second control.

```tsx
const [settings, setSettings] = useState({ desktop: true, email: false, mentions: true })

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline">Notifications</Button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent className="w-60">
    <DropdownMenuLabel>Notify me about</DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
      variant="switch"
      checked={settings.desktop}
      onCheckedChange={(desktop) => setSettings({ ...settings, desktop })}
    >
      <Monitor /> Desktop alerts
    </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
    {/* Email digest, Mentions … */}
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

## Links

A row that navigates stays a menu item: wrap the link with `asChild`, so it keeps the row’s styling, arrow-key focus and Enter to activate, while Next.js client navigation and Cmd/Ctrl-click keep working. Mark a link that leaves the site with a trailing `ArrowUpRight` at `size-4`.

```tsx
import NextLink from "next/link"

<DropdownMenuContent className="w-56">
  <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
    <NextLink href="/docs"><BookOpen /> Documentation</NextLink>
  </DropdownMenuItem>
  <DropdownMenuSeparator />
  <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
    <a href="https://github.com/jespinosa19/koala-ui" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
      <GithubLogo /> GitHub
      <ArrowUpRight className="ml-auto size-4" />
    </a>
  </DropdownMenuItem>
</DropdownMenuContent>
```

## Descriptions

A navigation menu often needs more than a label: a title over a sentence that says where the row goes. Put both in a `DropdownMenuItemText` after the leading icon, the sentence in a `DropdownMenuItemDescription`. A described row pins its icon to the title’s line instead of centering it on the block, and the sentence steps back by color and weight at the same size, so the title keeps the hierarchy. Give the content a wider measure (`w-80`) so the sentences wrap readably. Both parts are optional: a row without them stays a plain item.

```tsx
<DropdownMenuContent className="w-80">
  <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
    <NextLink href="/docs">
      <BookOpen />
      <DropdownMenuItemText>
        Documentation
        <DropdownMenuItemDescription>
          Guides, examples and the API for every component.
        </DropdownMenuItemDescription>
      </DropdownMenuItemText>
    </NextLink>
  </DropdownMenuItem>
  {/* …more rows */}
</DropdownMenuContent>
```

## Navigation

By default a sub-menu is nested: it flies out beside its row. Pass `submenu="navigation"` and it drills in place instead: its rows replace the menu's behind a Back row, and the surface resizes to fit. Use it for a deep menu, or one with no room beside it. The parts and the rows are the same, and so are the keys: `→` goes in, and `←` or `Esc` steps back one layer before the menu closes. It is the Dock's panel, opened from a trigger.

```tsx
<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline">Workspace</Button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent submenu="navigation" className="w-56">
    <DropdownMenuLabel>Koala UI</DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuItem>
      <SquaresFour /> Components
      <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘1</DropdownMenuShortcut>
    </DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem>
      <Browsers /> Templates
      <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘2</DropdownMenuShortcut>
    </DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuSub>
      <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
        <Palette /> Appearance
      </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuSubContent>
        <DropdownMenuLabel>Theme</DropdownMenuLabel>
        <DropdownMenuRadioGroup value={theme} onValueChange={setTheme}>
          <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="light">
            <Sun /> Light
          </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
          <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="dark">
            <Moon /> Dark
          </DropdownMenuRadioItem>
        </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
      </DropdownMenuSubContent>
    </DropdownMenuSub>
    <DropdownMenuSub>
      <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
        <Buildings /> Workspace
      </DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuSubContent>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <UsersThree /> Members
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem>
          <CreditCard /> Billing
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuSubContent>
    </DropdownMenuSub>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

## API reference

### DropdownMenu

The root, Radix `DropdownMenu.Root`; renders no DOM. Every part that renders an element accepts `className`, merged last.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | boolean | - | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen | boolean | false | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | Called when the menu opens or closes. |
| modal | boolean | true | Block pointer interaction with the page and trap focus while open. |
| dir | "ltr" \| "rtl" | - | Reading direction; flips sub-menus and arrow keys. |

### DropdownMenuTrigger

Opens the menu, Radix `DropdownMenu.Trigger`. Renders a `<button>` and forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | boolean | false | Merge onto your own element (a `Button`, an avatar button) instead of rendering a `<button>`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |
| data-disabled | Present when the trigger is disabled. |

### DropdownMenuContent

The menu surface, Radix `DropdownMenu.Content` portalled to the body (or to the full-screen element); forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| submenu | "nested" \| "navigation" | "nested" | How every `DropdownMenuSub` opens: a flyout beside its row, or a layer that replaces the rows in place behind a Back row. |
| side | "top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left" | "bottom" | Preferred side of the trigger; the menu flips when there is no room. |
| align | "start" \| "center" \| "end" | "center" | Alignment against the trigger. |
| sideOffset | number | 6 | Gap in pixels between the trigger and the menu. |
| alignOffset | number | 0 | Shift in pixels along the alignment axis. |
| collisionPadding | number | 0 | Distance in pixels kept from the viewport edge. |
| loop | boolean | false | Arrow keys wrap from the last row to the first. |
| container | HTMLElement \| null | - | Portal target. Defaults to the body, or the element that is full screen when the menu opens. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height for every row inside, 36px or 32px. Unset, the rows follow the nearest `DensityProvider`. |
| onCloseAutoFocus | (event: Event) => void | - | Called as focus returns to the trigger on close; `preventDefault()` to send it elsewhere. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | (event: KeyboardEvent) => void | - | Called on Escape; in navigation mode Escape first steps back a layer. |
| onInteractOutside | (event: Event) => void | - | Called on a pointer down or focus outside the menu; `preventDefault()` keeps it open. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |
| data-side | The side the menu actually opened on, after collisions. |
| data-align | `"start"`, `"center"` or `"end"`. |
| data-submenu | `"nested"` or `"navigation"`. |

| CSS variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --surface | Set to `var(--popover)`, read by nested Inputs and Selects. |
| --radix-dropdown-menu-trigger-width | The trigger's width, for a menu that matches it (`w-(--radix-dropdown-menu-trigger-width)`). |
| --radix-dropdown-menu-content-available-height | Height left between the trigger and the viewport edge, for capping a long menu. |
| --radix-dropdown-menu-content-transform-origin | The trigger-side origin, for a custom entrance. |

### DropdownMenuItem

A row, Radix `DropdownMenu.Item` (a `<div role="menuitem">`); forwards all its props. Put a leading icon first and a `DropdownMenuShortcut` last.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| variant | "default" \| "destructive" | "default" | Destructive tints the label, the leading icon and the highlight red. |
| inset | boolean | false | Indent the text to line up with icon-bearing siblings. |
| onSelect | (event: Event) => void | - | Called when the row is chosen; `preventDefault()` keeps the menu open. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Dims the row and skips it in keyboard navigation. |
| textValue | string | - | Text used for typeahead when the row's content is not plain text. |
| asChild | boolean | false | Merge onto your own element, e.g. a `next/link`, keeping the row's styling and keys. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-highlighted | Present on the row under the pointer or keyboard focus. |
| data-disabled | Present when the row is disabled. |
| data-inset | Present on an `inset` row. |

### DropdownMenuItemText

The title and description column of a described row, placed after the leading icon. Forwards all native `<span>` props.

### DropdownMenuItemDescription

The muted sentence under a row's title, inside `DropdownMenuItemText`; the leading icon then pins to the title's line. Forwards all native `<span>` props.

### DropdownMenuCheckboxItem

A toggle row, Radix `DropdownMenu.CheckboxItem` (`role="menuitemcheckbox"`); forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| checked | boolean \| "indeterminate" | - | The checked state. |
| onCheckedChange | (checked: boolean) => void | - | Called when the row is toggled. |
| variant | "check" \| "switch" | "check" | A brand check on the right, or a mini Switch on the same line for a setting that applies at once. |
| closeOnSelect | boolean | true | Close the menu on toggle. Defaults to `false` when `variant="switch"`. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Dims the row and skips it in keyboard navigation. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"checked"`, `"unchecked"` or `"indeterminate"`. |
| data-highlighted | Present on the row under the pointer or keyboard focus. |
| data-disabled | Present when the row is disabled. |

### DropdownMenuRadioGroup

Groups radio rows into one exclusive choice, Radix `DropdownMenu.RadioGroup`. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | string | - | The selected value. |
| onValueChange | (value: string) => void | - | Called when another row is chosen. |

### DropdownMenuRadioItem

One choice in a `DropdownMenuRadioGroup`, Radix `DropdownMenu.RadioItem`; shows the same brand check as a checkbox row. Forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value* | string | - | The value this row selects. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Dims the row and skips it in keyboard navigation. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"checked"` or `"unchecked"`. |
| data-highlighted | Present on the row under the pointer or keyboard focus. |
| data-disabled | Present when the row is disabled. |

### DropdownMenuLabel

A muted caption over a run of rows, Radix `DropdownMenu.Label`; not focusable. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| inset | boolean | false | Indent to line up with icon-bearing rows. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

### DropdownMenuGroup

Groups related rows (`role="group"`), Radix `DropdownMenu.Group`. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### DropdownMenuSeparator

A hairline between groups that stops at the ring's inner edge, Radix `DropdownMenu.Separator`. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

### DropdownMenuShortcut

A display-only key hint pushed to the row's end: the small gray `Kbd` chip. Forwards all `Kbd` props; it binds no key.

### DropdownMenuSub

Pairs a `DropdownMenuSubTrigger` with the `DropdownMenuSubContent` it opens, Radix `DropdownMenu.Sub`; renders no DOM.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | boolean | - | Controlled open state. Ignored in navigation mode, where the menu owns the open branch. |
| defaultOpen | boolean | false | Initial open state when uncontrolled; nested mode only. |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | Called when the sub-menu opens or closes; nested mode only. |

### DropdownMenuSubTrigger

The row that opens a sub-menu, with a trailing caret; Radix `DropdownMenu.SubTrigger`, or a plain item in navigation mode. Forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| inset | boolean | false | Indent the text to line up with icon-bearing siblings. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Dims the row and skips it in keyboard navigation. |
| textValue | string | - | Text used for typeahead. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"` (nested mode). |
| data-highlighted | Present on the row under the pointer or keyboard focus. |
| data-disabled | Present when the row is disabled. |

### DropdownMenuSubContent

The sub-menu, Radix `DropdownMenu.SubContent`: a surface beside its row in nested mode, or rows that take the menu's place in navigation mode (where `className` and the positioning props do not apply).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| backLabel | string | "Back" | Navigation mode: label of the row that returns to the parent layer. |
| sideOffset | number | 0 | Gap in pixels between the row and the flyout. |
| alignOffset | number | 0 | Shift in pixels along the row. |
| loop | boolean | false | Arrow keys wrap from the last row to the first. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Row height, 36px or 32px. Falls back to the menu's `density`, then the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |
| data-side | The side the flyout opened on. |

### DropdownMenuPortal

Radix `DropdownMenu.Portal`, exported for custom compositions; `DropdownMenuContent` already portals itself.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| container | HTMLElement \| null | document.body | Where the portal mounts. |
| forceMount | true | - | Keep the children mounted while closed. |

## FAQ

### When should I use a Dropdown Menu versus a Select?

Use DropdownMenu for a list of actions or commands fired from a trigger, like a row's more-actions menu or an account menu. Reach for Select when the user is choosing a value to submit in a form; the menu's items run callbacks rather than holding a form value.

### How do I make an arbitrary element the trigger?

Pass `asChild` to DropdownMenuTrigger and render your own element inside it, such as an Avatar button or a ghost iconOnly Button. Radix merges the trigger behavior and ARIA onto your element instead of rendering its own button.

### What is the difference between DropdownMenuCheckboxItem and DropdownMenuRadioItem?

DropdownMenuCheckboxItem is an independent toggle driven by its own `checked` state, while DropdownMenuRadioItem is one mutually exclusive choice inside a DropdownMenuRadioGroup with a shared `value`. Both render the same Check indicator, since the exclusive-versus-toggle semantics live in the ARIA role and grouping, not the glyph.

### Does DropdownMenuShortcut actually bind the keyboard shortcut?

No. DropdownMenuShortcut is purely decorative right-aligned text rendered through the shared Kbd primitive, so it just displays the hint like ⌘P. Wire up the real key binding in your app with a global listener.

### How do I keep items aligned when some have leading icons and others do not?

Pass the `inset` prop to DropdownMenuItem (or DropdownMenuLabel and DropdownMenuSubTrigger) to add left padding that lines text up with icon-bearing siblings. This keeps a mixed list visually aligned without adding a placeholder icon.

### How do I style a destructive action like Delete or Log out?

Pass `variant="destructive"` to DropdownMenuItem. It colors the label red and, unlike the default muted leading icon, colors that icon red too so the whole row reads as one destructive unit; the hover background tints red to match. The check indicator on checkbox and radio items is never affected.

### How do I change the menu's row height?

Rows are compact (32px) by default. For 36px rows, set `density="comfortable"` on DropdownMenuContent and every row inside follows, sub-menus included. Without it, rows follow the nearest DensityProvider, even through the portal. A row's own `density` still wins, for a one-off. The edge line and the concentric corners stay the same at either size.

### Does the menu open over an element that is full screen?

Yes. DropdownMenuContent is portalled to the body, or to the element that is full screen when the menu opens, because the browser paints nothing outside that element over the screen. Pass `container` to portal it somewhere else.

### How far do icons sit from the menu's edge?

12px, measured from the outer edge of the menu: 4px of content padding plus 8px of row padding. The edge is drawn as an inset ring rather than a border, so it takes no layout space and the sum stays exact. Leading icons, label text, shortcuts, the submenu caret and the selection check all sit on that 12px line, left and right. An `inset` row starts its text at 40px from the edge (4px + 36px), which lines it up with the text of icon-bearing siblings.

### Should a sub-menu fly out or drill in place?

Fly out (the default, `submenu="nested"`) when the menu is shallow and has room beside it: the parent stays visible, so it reads as a side trip. Drill in place (`submenu="navigation"` on DropdownMenuContent) when the menu is two or more levels deep, sits near a screen edge, or opens on a phone: each layer takes the menu's place behind a Back row, so nothing ever opens off-screen. It is set once for the whole menu, the parts are the same, and DropdownMenuSubContent takes `backLabel` to rename the Back row. In this mode the sub takes the menu's width, so size the content, not the sub.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli@latest add dropdown-menu` writes `components/ui/dropdown-menu/`. Import from `@/components/ui/dropdown-menu`:

- Components and helpers: `DropdownMenu`, `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `DropdownMenuGroup`, `DropdownMenuRadioGroup`, `DropdownMenuSub`, `DropdownMenuPortal`, `DropdownMenuContent`, `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuItemText`, `DropdownMenuItemDescription`, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem`, `DropdownMenuRadioItem`, `DropdownMenuLabel`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`, `DropdownMenuShortcut`, `DropdownMenuSubTrigger`, `DropdownMenuSubContent`, `dropdownMenuVariants`
- Types: `DropdownMenuContentProps`, `DropdownMenuItemProps`, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItemProps`, `DropdownMenuRadioItemProps`, `DropdownMenuLabelProps`, `DropdownMenuSubProps`, `DropdownMenuSubTriggerProps`, `DropdownMenuSubContentProps`
- Koala components it installs with it: `kbd`, `switch`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `density`, `motion`, `tv`, `utils`
- npm packages: `@phosphor-icons/react`, `radix-ui`
